title: Monotonicity of a Rational Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find intervals of increase/decrease and local extrema for f(x) = x^2 / (x - 1).
finalAnswer: \text{Increasing on } (-\infty, 0) \cup (2, \infty); \; \text{Decreasing on } (0, 1) \cup (1, 2); \; \text{Local Max at } (0, 0); \; \text{Local Min at } (2, 4)

steps.title: Identify Partition Points
steps.mathExpression: f'(x) = 0 \implies x = 0, \; 2; \quad f' \text{ undefined at } x = 1 \text{ (vertical asymptote)}

steps.title: Classify Extrema
steps.mathExpression: x = 0: (+ \to -) \implies \text{Local Max at } (0, 0); \quad x = 2: (- \to +) \implies \text{Local Min at } (2, 4)
